description: R08 Functional Closeout checkpoint: retire the final TerminalCore functional Partial after the Microsoft GH#637 Alt+Shift character contract passed Rust CI and Quality Census on the published witness HEAD.

entries.notes: Rust drives the real TerminalInput fallback with Microsoft's SendCharEvent-equivalent translated character event: LeftAlt prefixes ESC for lowercase a, and LeftAlt+Shift preserves the already translated uppercase A while still prefixing ESC.
